states.name: Raging
states.note: Set by Barbarian Rage. Gates the rage damage bonus and advantage.

states.name: Unarmored
states.note: Wearing no armor and no shield. Gates Unarmored Defense and Monk speed.

states.name: Two Weapons
states.note: Attacking or fighting with two separate weapons in the Attack action.

states.name: Concentrating
states.note: Maintaining a concentration effect.

states.name: Hidden
states.note: Unseen by enemies. Gates Vanish and similar stealth features.

states.name: Mounted
states.note: On a mount.

states.name: Half Cover
states.note: Already tracked by Character.activeStates.

states.name: Three-Quarters Cover
states.note: Already tracked by Character.activeStates.

states.name: Total Cover
states.note: Already tracked by Character.activeStates.

states.name: Difficult Terrain
states.note: Already tracked by Character.activeStates.

states.name: Shapeshifted
states.note: Currently in an alternate form, e.g. via Wild Shape.

states.name: Transformed
states.note: Currently altered by a transform effect such as Alter Self.

states.name: Bloodied
states.note: At or below half hit points, no greater than 0. Gates Bloodied feats.

states.name: Unarmed
states.note: Not wielding a weapon.

states.name: No Armor
states.note: Wearing no armor, whether or not a shield is held.

states.name: Wielding a Finesse Weapon
states.note: Equipment state. Gates Defensive Duelist and similar feats.

states.name: Wielding a Heavy Weapon
states.note: Equipment state. Gates Great Weapon Master's benefit.

states.name: Wielding a Shield
states.note: Equipment state. Defensive Duelist's AC bonus is lost while a shield is held.

states.name: Wearing Heavy Armor
states.note: Equipment state. Most Barbarian and Monk speed and defense benefits are lost while worn.

states.name: Holding Two Weapons
states.note: Equipment state, distinct from the two_weapons combat state which requires actually attacking with both.

states.name: Wearing Armor
states.note: Any armor. Gates Fighting Style: Defense.

states.name: Wielding Two Weapons
states.note: A melee weapon in each hand. Gates Fighting Style: Dueling.

states.name: In Favourable Terrain
states.note: In terrain the ranger favours. Gates Primeval Awareness.

states.name: Is a Ranger
states.note: Class membership, for features that only apply to one class.
